object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: With read-only mode off, change an object and commit from the Document Editor. Expected: the window is in read-only mode, with the banner shown and the Read-only action checked. On a document with no uncommitted change, enter a tag in the commit dialog. Expected: the tag names the latest commit and the window is in read-only mode. Cancel the commit dialog; and, separately, enter a tag that another program created meanwhile. Expected: read-only mode stays off both times.
